_: PROJ (Projectile) + EXPL (Explosion) builders — give a custom destruction spell its OWN flying bolt + boom on impact. Chain: custom EXPL (damage+radius, vanilla fire light/sound/imagespace so it's visible+audible) <- custom PROJ (type Missile, flag Explosion, model = the REAL vanilla firebolt nif so the bolt is visible, explosion = our EXPL) <- custom MGEF (projectile = our PROJ) <- custom Aimed FireAndForget SPEL. All vanilla art FormIDs were decoded from Skyrim.esm via Mutagen (FireboltProjectile01 0x012E84 / ExplosionFireBoltExpert01 0x10FBE9) — do NOT invent nif paths (a wrong path = an INVISIBLE projectile).
_ingame_test: 1) coc qasmoke (or any cell with a wall). 2) `player.addspell <FormID of MF_FXFirebolt>` — or learn it via console: open console, `help "MF Custom Firebolt"` to find the SPEL FormID, then `player.addspell <id>`. 3) Equip it and cast at a wall or dummy: you should see OUR firebolt-art bolt fly out (custom PROJ) and a fire explosion + damage on impact (custom EXPL). The bolt art is the real vanilla Magic\FireBoltProjectile.nif so it is visible; the boom uses vanilla fire imagespace/sound so it reads as a fire blast.

explosions.name: Custom Firebolt Blast
explosions._: The boom on impact. Vanilla art decoded from ExplosionFireBoltExpert01 (Skyrim.esm:0x10FBE9): FX model Effects\FXEmptyExplosionArt.nif, sound 0x02518F (EXPFireballImpactSet... fire impact), imageSpaceModifier 0x10FBE8. damage/radius are OURS (vanilla firebolt expert is 0 direct damage — the MGEF carries the damage there; here we add a small AoE punch so the explosion itself is felt). force/isRadius mirror the vanilla feel.

projectiles.name: Custom Firebolt
projectiles._: The flying bolt. model is the REAL vanilla firebolt nif (decoded from FireboltProjectile01 0x012E84 = Magic\FireBoltProjectile.nif) so it is VISIBLE. type Missile (firebolt-style straight bolt). flag Explosion = trigger the explosion on impact. explosion = our in-spec EXPL (resolved by editorId — Explosions build before Projectiles). light reuses the vanilla firebolt light 0x01CBB3 so the bolt glows; sound 0x03C8FE is the vanilla firebolt travel sound. speed/range/gravity tuned firebolt-like.

magicEffects.name: Custom Firebolt
magicEffects.description: A firebolt that hurls a searing bolt at the target.
magicEffects._: Aimed fire damage. Functional fields mirror vanilla FireDamageFFAimed75. projectile = OUR custom PROJ (the It-new field reused from shout work) so the spell flies our bolt. The direct hit damage rides the MGEF magnitude; the EXPL adds its own AoE damage on top. castingArt reuses vanilla firebolt cast art 0x01B211 so the caster's hand lights up.

spells.name: MF Custom Firebolt
spells._: The castable spell. Aimed FireAndForget. equipType EitherHand (Skyrim.esm:0x013F44) so it can be equipped into a hand and cast. magnitude 25 = firebolt-tier direct hit. player.addspell-able.
